title: Western Blot Analysis
author: Unknown
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.iejcbcn

steps.title: Collect Cell Pellet
steps.instruction: Place cells in a microcentrifuge tube and centrifuge to collect the cell pellet.

steps.title: Lyse Cells and Prepare Protein
steps.instruction: Lyse cells in RIPA buffer and prepare the protein denaturation.

substeps.instruction: Use RIPA buffer containing 10 mM Tris-HCl, 1 mM EDTA, 1% sodium dodecyl sulfate (SDS), 1% NP-40, 1:100 proteinase inhibitor cocktail, 50 mM β-glycerophosphate, and 50 mM sodium fluoride
Centrifuge at 14000 rpm for 30 min at 4°C
Transfer the supernatant to a new tube and discard the pellet
Test the concentration of the supernatant

steps.title: Load Samples onto Gel
steps.instruction: Load up to 40 µl of sample into each well of a 1.5 mm thick gel, selecting the gel percentage based on the target protein size.

steps.title: Transfer Proteins to Membrane
steps.instruction: Transfer the proteins to PVDF membranes using a semi-dry transfer apparatus (Bio-Rad, Hercules, CA, USA) following the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Block and Incubate with Primary Antibody
steps.instruction: Block the membranes and incubate with primary antibodies.

substeps.instruction: Blot membranes with 5% dehydrated milk for 1 h
Incubate with primary antibodies overnight at 4°C with agitation

steps.title: Wash Membrane
steps.instruction: Wash the membrane with TBST three times for 10 minutes each.

steps.title: Incubate with Secondary Antibody
steps.instruction: Incubate the membrane for 1 hour at room temperature with HRP-conjugated secondary antibody.

substeps.instruction: Dilute secondary antibody 1:5000 in 5% nonfat dry milk/TBST

steps.title: Wash Membrane
steps.instruction: Wash the membrane with TBST three times for 10 minutes each.

steps.title: Develop and Expose Blots
steps.instruction: Incubate the membrane with ECL substrate and expose to X-ray film.

substeps.instruction: Incubate membrane (protein side up) with ECL for 1-2 minutes using a final volume of 0.125 ml/cm²
Drain excess detection reagent, wrap the blots, and smooth out air bubbles
Place wrapped blots (protein side up) in an X-ray film cassette
Expose to X-ray film for 5 seconds to 60 minutes
